According to the paper, the estimate is as follows:

* For NMC 111, nearly 10 kilotons of cobalt are needed to produce 1 million EVs.
* For NMC 811/NCA, producing >150 million EVs by 2050 would require more than 2.5 million metric tons of usable cobalt, which represents more than one third of the known global Co reserves (≈7 million metric tons).
